title: Restless Tomb
description: A stone sarcophagus lies open, its heavy lid shoved aside with inhuman force. Claw marks score the interior walls where the occupant dragged itself free, and a trail of grave dirt leads off into the darkness. Whatever rose from this tomb is long gone, but it left its burial goods behind.

choices.label: Search the tomb
choices.description: The risen dead seldom take their gold with them.

choices.label: Collect the spectral wood
choices.description: The coffin's inner frame is made of wood suffused with spectral energy.

choices.label: Harvest the wraith threads
choices.description: Gossamer strands of ectoplasm cling to the sarcophagus lid.
